_readme: Copy to appsettings.Worker.Production.json, replace every <...> value, and give it to dashboard\Install-CopilotInsights.ps1 -WorkerServer -WorkerSettingsFile on the one server that runs the worker; it is installed next to the worker as appsettings.Production.json. On every run the installer writes ConnectionStrings:GovernanceWorker (the governance database) and ConnectionStrings:Insights (the Copilot database, from which the nightly seat read takes Copilot activity, as the site's manual read does) from its own -SqlServer, -GovernanceDatabase and -Database, and fills in Notifications:WorkbenchBaseUrl (the site's address, without /workbench) where it is still <...>. These are the exact names the worker reads (governance/src/Governance.Worker, Governance.Infrastructure, Governance.Notifications). No secrets here: Graph, Power Platform and the channel flow use the worker certificate found by subject (LocalMachine\My is searched after CurrentUser\My), SQL uses Windows authentication as the worker gMSA. The ITSM password and the channel flow URL carry secrets: they go in the worker service's own environment (Itsm__Password, Notifications__ChannelFlowUrl), which installer reruns keep, never in this file (governance/deploy/Deploy-Production.md, step 8.3).

Tenant.WorkerClientId: <Worker app registration client ID for this environment>
Tenant.TeamsAppId: <Teams app ID from the org catalog>
Tenant.CatalogId: <entitlement management catalog ID of the governed access packages>

Notifications.SmtpHost: <internal SMTP relay host, or empty for no fallback>
